title: Pumpkin seeds: 6 minerals
nutrition_source: USDA FoodData Central FDC 170556 (pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried), per 30 g; % of FDA Daily Values
caption:
30 g of pumpkin seeds = 6 key minerals 🎃

Per small handful (30 g):
• Manganese 59% DV
• Copper 45% DV
• Magnesium 42% DV
• Phosphorus 30% DV

• Iron 15% DV
• 9 g plant protein

Magnesium supports muscles and nerves, zinc supports normal immunity, iron helps carry oxygen in the blood, and phosphorus keeps bones and teeth strong.

scenes.say: This small handful of pumpkin seeds packs six key minerals. Here's how much.
Thirty grams gives you about fifty nine percent of your daily manganese, forty five percent copper, and forty two percent magnesium.
Plus thirty percent phosphorus, twenty one percent zinc, fifteen percent iron, and nine grams of plant protein.
Magnesium supports muscles and nerves. Zinc supports normal immunity. Iron helps carry oxygen in your blood. Phosphorus builds strong bones and teeth.
Roast them lightly, sprinkle them on curd or oats, or snack on them instead of biscuits.
